data.description:
The Oct 15 nightly import overwrote products because `product_id` is only unique **within** a store. Store 3 and Store 7 both have product_id 10452 (different items).

Fix: key products by `(store_id, product_id)`. Code change is in apollo-data-importer PR "Use (store_id, product_id) as key" (author Priya Shah, reviewer Maya Cohen).

See Notion: Bug triage – duplicate product IDs.
